name: Stats and highlights
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Stats and highlights.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Layout
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.how: Turn on “Show dividers (inline only)” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.how: Enter the section title. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.
